check_definitions.i: ICD-code-like patterns in structured (non-narrative) text: ICD-10 \b[A-TV-Z]\d{2}(\.\d{1,4})?\b and ICD-9 \b\d{3}\.\d{1,2}\b; also reported with the numeric value/dose/reference columns of the lab, vitals and medication tables removed, since lab values (e.g. 145.0) legitimately match the ICD-9 shape and drug names such as 'Vitamin B12' match the ICD-10 shape
check_definitions.ii: long titles of the four phenotype codes, case-insensitive, narrative and structured counted separately
check_definitions.iii: demographic field labels (race, insurance, language, ethnicity, marital) as whole words in structured text
check_definitions.iv: 8-digit integers \b[12]\d{7}\b, structured and narrative counted separately (narrative hits would be numbers inside de-identified note text, not leaked identifiers)
check_definitions.v: cell labels 'code+/note', 'code-/note', 'recovery' anywhere; the plain word 'recovery' occurs in clinical narrative (e.g. 'recovery room') and is counted separately
check_definitions.vi: markup/highlighting tokens '<mark', '**', '[MASK]', '[[' anywhere, structured and narrative counted separately
check_definitions.vii: the chart's own hadm_id, subject_id and radiology note_ids as substrings, structured and narrative counted separately
